scope: Exact notarized production build 3, simulated download quarantine, actual Finder launch and Gatekeeper confirmation, AppTranslocation, isolated fresh profile, no device selection or input
quarantine_setup: com.apple.quarantine 0081 applied to disposable extracted app; not cleared and no security exception added
gatekeeper_message: Apple checked the app for malicious software and none was detected
clean_host_finder_confirmation: not_exercised; clean-host native entrypoint and update reports remain separate

checks.name: Exact production archive, strict signature, stapled ticket and Gatekeeper assessment
Finder shows the downloaded-app confirmation for the notarized TapMesh app
AppTranslocation launches the native workspace connected to a fresh isolated profile
Local HTTP denies unauthenticated access and exposes 50 authenticated schemas
Translocated MCP bridge initializes and exposes 50 tools with system-only PATH
Closing the workspace leaves no visible workspace window while HTTP/MCP, credentials and instance remain available
Finder reopens the connected workspace without replacing credentials or runtime instance
Native Quit stops owned listeners, preserves the bundle signature and restores the temporary GUI environment

observation_notes: Initial CUA app binding timed out while the Finder first-open confirmation was still pending; a not-responding dialog from that binding was dismissed. The underlying downloaded-app confirmation was then observed and accepted. Successful runtime checks began only after that confirmation.

Reading the closed app through the CUA app binding reopened its window. That first close observation was not counted as a closed-window test. A separate close used Finder observation and a PID/executable-bound read-only window probe, then independently verified HTTP/MCP while the workspace window was absent.
